title: Champion
summary: Champions are special units in Monster Train 2. Champions are usually some of the strongest units available, though their role varies widely, with some based around dealing damage and others based around support or even permanently scaling your other units. Each clan has two Champions, one primary and one alternate. Primary Champions are available from the start, while alternate Champions are unlocked at level 5.

title: Starter Cards
summary: Each [[Champion]] has an associated Starter Card: an undraftable common card, costing {{Ember|0}} or {{Ember|1}}, that's either a unit or a spell.

title: Shield Steward
tables: '''Strengthstone''' and '''Heartstone''' are cheap upgrades that provide a lot of security into the early game, if you can spare around {{Gold|40}}. They might let you survive [[Legion]] or [[Elebor the Wall]] where you would otherwise die. Most other clan-specific upgrades, like {{IconLink|Bravestone}}, {{IconLink|Mossystone}}, and {{IconLink|Furystone}} will accomplish roughly the same job, so you don't need to reroll the shop.

Assuming you have [[Steward's Quarters]], '''Frenzystone''' gives '''Shield Steward''' {{IconLink|Multistrike|2}}, allowing it to scale quite well with {{Attack}} buffs. Be absolutely certain you don't have a better unit to take this upgrade, though.
Assuming you have [[Steward's Quarters]], '''Smidgestone''' can help you assemble a room full of '''Shield Stewards'''.

If find the [[Beacon]] event and you do not want to take [[Beacon's Light]], '''Purified Essence''' provides a tremendous stat boost with no downside, since '''Shield Steward''' already has no card text. This can be an especially good choice if this event comes just before the Ring 3 boss, and can let the unit still serve decently into the later game.

title: Covenant Ranks
summary: Covenant Ranks are the difficulty system in Monster Train 2, going from the easiest difficulty at Covenant 0 to the hardest at Covenant 10. Only Covenant Ranks 0 and 1 are initially available, and the rest must be unlocked by beating each Covenant in ascending order. Covenant Ranks 1-9 and Covenant Rank 10 each have their own winstreak counter.

title: Pyre of Dominion
summary:
{{PyreHeart
|image = PyreOfDominion.png
|stats = 30/65
|effects = Remove Train Stewards and starting cards. Immediately draft four packs, and double each card picked.
|unlock = Defeat the Titans.
|ring3_stat_increase = +20/+15
|ring6_stat_increase = +35/+15

Pyre of Dominion is one of the [[Pyre Hearts]] in Monster Train 2. It immediately removes all Train Stewards and [[starter cards]]. The player then drafts from the following packs, gaining two copies of each card:
* Primary clan uncommon pack
* Allied clan uncommon pack
* Primary clan unit banner
* Allied clan unit banner
The cards cannot be skipped.

title: Equipment
summary: Equipment is a card type in Monster Train 2. Equipment cards are attached to units on the train. Once attached, they provide the unit with new abilities, effects, and sometimes {{Attack}} and/or {{Health}}. Equipment can only be played on friendly units, with the exceptions of [[Penitent's Bloodsuit]] and [[Penitent's Deathsuit]].

Armory is a map node in Monster Train 2. It allows you to obtain one of 3 random [[Equipment]] or [[Room]] cards. Cards have an approximate 1.0% chance of being Common, an 87.1% chance of being Uncommon, and an 11.9% chance of being rare.
